scope: Registered three-fixture compressed postflop suite on RTX 5090; three alternating fresh-original/candidate pairs, sum of fixture medians. Tree construction, GPU initialization including runtime NVRTC/JIT, fixed-quality solve/checks and full readback are included. Cargo compilation, fingerprinting, final destruction, API/browser latency and disk saving are excluded. Warm-cache observations do not qualify cold-start behavior; no significance, universal tree/range/device or F32-speed claim. Cumulative gain includes retained E004/E015 plus E020; the separately measured E020 increment is not added to prior percentages.
